en.sayed-ali-raza: because hopes are the mainstay of fools. It is wise to preserve one’s experience. Your best experience is that which teaches you a lesson.
Make use of leisure before it changes into (the hour of) grief.
Every seeker does not achieve (what he seeks); and every departed does not return.
To lose provision and to earn evil for the Day of Judgement means ruin.
Every matter has a consequence. What is destined for you will shortly come to you.
A trader undertakes a risk. Often a small quantity is more beneficial than a large quantity.
There is no good in an ignoble helper, nor in a suspicious friend.
Be compliant with the world as long as it is in your grip.
Do not put yourself to risk as regards anything in expectation for more than that.
Beware lest the feeling of enmity should overpower you.
